name: Alpha Homora v2 HomoraBank zero debt-share borrow
summary: HomoraBank v2's permissionless resolveReserve raised a bank's totalDebt without minting debt shares, and borrow() converted amounts to shares with truncating division, recording zero debt for borrows below totalDebt/totalShare. After shrinking the sUSD bank to one share, the attacker borrowed sUSD for free repeatedly via its own spell, used it as Iron Bank collateral and drained other markets.
notes: The attacker's earlier executes (0xcc57ac77 borrow, 0xf31ee9d9 repay) were ordinary 1:1 share operations that set the sUSD bank to one share; resolveReserve here is the first share-less debt increase, so it anchors. Their 1,000 sUSD loan round-tripped.
HomoraBank v2 is 0x5f5cd910…; 0xba5ebaf3… is the replacement bank deployed in April 2021. The upgrade to 0x33bf0bb8 is the last route change before the exploit.

Loss is per-tx Iron Bank market outflow (loss.mjs, DefiLlama). The ~61M sUSD free-borrowed and redeposited as cySUSD nets out within each tx; the 420,595 sUSD taken in 0xd7a91172 and swapped to USDC did not, and the attacker's cySUSD collateral is not subtracted.
